name: context-guru
description: Installs a local context-guru proxy, routes this project's Claude Code sessions through it, and reports what it saved. Reversible: /context-guru:uninstall removes the one settings key it adds and stops the proxy.

port.title: Proxy port
port.description: Local port the proxy listens on. The port must be FIXED rather than negotiated: the ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL written into your settings and the session hook that starts the proxy have to agree, and a URL cannot be renegotiated after it is written. Default 8787 — deliberately not 4000, which collides with litellm.

preset.title: Preset
preset.description: Compaction PIPELINE - what happens to the request body. `cache` (the default) runs the prompt-cache split and NOTHING else: no content dropped, no markers, no extra tool. `codesmart` adds the offloaders once you want them. This option does not decide whether idle keep-alive pings are sent: that is `cache_strategy`, and the default one DOES make model calls. Read both before assuming nothing is spent.

cache_strategy.title: Cache strategy
cache_strategy.description: Which cache mechanism runs, by NAME, so switching back is one word rather than four tuning numbers. `5-min-ping` (the default) is the split PLUS an idle ping just under the provider's 5-minute TTL - at most 2 per idle span, only on prefixes over 20k tokens, capped at $0.25 a ping - and it SPENDS YOUR OWN CREDENTIAL while nobody is at the keyboard, which is the whole point: it is what keeps the cache warm across a gap. `split` is the split alone: no pings, no spend. `1-hour-head` asks for the 1-hour tier on the tools/system breakpoints instead, and only on requests with a >=50k-token prefix - under that it does nothing at all. Measured GRANTED on Haiku 4.5 and silently DOWNGRADED on Sonnet 5, so on Opus/Sonnet expect $0 until Usage.CacheWrite1h says otherwise; both of those measurements were on prefixes below the 50k gate, so a small-prefix session sees $0 for two separate reasons. Change it any time with /context-guru:cache-strategy-picker; it takes effect at the proxy's next start.

idle_exit.title: Idle exit
idle_exit.description: Exit the proxy after this long with no requests and no keep-alive ping pending, so nothing is left running on your machine. Must be at least 2x the store's entry lifetime (~5h34m at the default), because exiting clears in-memory cache state.

upstream.title: Upstream base URL
upstream.description: Forward to this Anthropic-compatible base URL instead of api.anthropic.com. Set it when something else is already the gateway — a hosted agent pod, a corporate gateway — so the proxy CHAINS behind it rather than replacing it. That gateway keeps holding the credential and, on at least one pod, rewriting model names: bypassing it sends model ids the real API has never heard of and every request fails. Empty means go straight to Anthropic.
